title: The film is a folder on disk
chose: One self-contained folder per film, with thesium.json as its manifest

over.name: An app server with a database
over.why: It would put a server and a schema between the person and their film.

over.name: A cloud workspace
over.why: The film would travel off the machine that made it.

because: Films stay local and private, and any agent can read a plain folder without a tool.
tradeoff: There is no shared state between films, so every film repeats its own kit copy.
